payload.title: Regular-session RVOL
payload.description: RVOL now uses most recent bar with meaningful volume (>10% avg), not real-time tick volume. Prevents false 0-RVOL on after-hours scans.

payload.title: Entry zone computation
payload.description: Entry zone = EMA21 ceiling to max(support, VP-VAL) floor. Uses volume profile value area low as structural floor.

payload.title: Structural stop-loss
payload.description: Stop = min(prior swing low, VP-VAL, EMA50) - 0.5*ATR buffer. Replaces generic 2*ATR stop.

payload.title: WATCH-to-BUY auto-promote
payload.description: Step 5f: if WATCH price is within entry_low-entry_high and R:R>=2.0, auto-promote to BUY with pullback-entry reason.

payload.title: Sector rotation bonus
payload.description: Step 5f-pre: +3 score pts for tickers in sectors outperforming SPY by >2%. Follows institutional capital flow.
